items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency subjected him to a hostile work environment on the bases of race (African-American), color (Black), and age (52) when, on December 11, 2020, Supervisor refused to render first aide to Complainant for a bleeding head wound and verbally assaulted Complainant when he screamed to Complainant, "Get your ass back on the plane, you do not do shit every day, I want you off my fucking team immediately, and I am tired of your shit.” At the conclusion of the investigation, the Agency provided Complainant with a copy of the report of investigation and notice of his right to request a hearing before an Equal Employment Opportunity Commission Administrative Judge (AJ).
On [MASK], the AJ issued a Notice of Proposed Summary Judgment (Notice) and provided each of the parties an opportunity to respond.
[MASK] stated without providing supporting evidence that Supervisor has a history of hatred towards him and of mistreatment of other African-Americans at work.
[MASK] asserted for the first time that Supervisor made comments about President Obama and displayed images of the confederate flag in the hangar.
Over Complainant's objections, the AJ issued a decision without a hearing on [MASK].
